title: Vengurla Point, Aguada, Kundapur, Bhatkal & Kaup दीपस्तंभों के लिए lawn mower की खरीद (Procurement of lawn mowers for Vengurla Point, Aguada, Kundapur, Bhatkal & Kaup lighthouses)
summary: GeM bid for supply, installation and demonstration of five petrol ride-on lawn mowers, one each for Bhatkal, Kundapur, Kaup, Vengurla Point and Aguada lighthouses, for the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa

sites.name: Bhatkal Lighthouse, Bandar Road, Post Mavinkurve, Tal. Bhatkal, Dist. Uttar Kannada 581320
Kundapur Lighthouse, Post Kodi, Kundapur, Dist. Udupi, Karnataka 576217
Kaup Lighthouse, Tal. Kaup, Dist. Udupi 574106
Vengurla (At Post Vengurla, Taluka Vengurla, Dist. Sindhudurg 416516)
Aguada Lighthouse & DGPS Station, Post Candolim, Sinquerim, Mapusa 403515

scope.item: Lawn Mowers (Q3) - ride-on, petrol engine, all wheel drive; supply, installation, on-site demo, testing, commissioning and operator training

money.notes: Estimated bid value Rs 23,75,000 (GeM guidance value). EMD advisory bank SBI; EMD exemption per GeM GTC for MSE manufacturers. Reserved for Make in India Class 1 local suppliers (min 50% local content); MSE purchase preference L1+15% for 25% quantity. Warranty service within 10 days or penalty 0.5% of unit price per week, max 10%.

period.warranty: Minimum 01 year on-site warranty on equipment, prime mover and battery

eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover of bidder (3 years): Rs 12 lakh; OEM average turnover: Rs 94 lakh
3 years past experience in same/similar category; past performance 30% of bid quantity; MSE and startup exemption from experience and turnover allowed
OEM authorization certificate; ISO 9001 certification for bidder or OEM
Dedicated/toll-free service support number and escalation matrix
specs: Ride-on lawn mower, petrol engine 12000-12999 W, key start, variable speed, all wheel drive, 5 forward gears plus reverse, max speed 13 km/h
Rotary type, 2 hardened steel blades, electromagnetic blade engagement, stamped steel deck, cut width 1050-1074 mm, cut height 25-102 mm, single lever adjustment
4 rubberized wheels (front 300 mm, rear 480 mm), power steering, high back seat, 400 litre grass catcher with manual dumping, no mulching kit
Mowing area 6000 sq m; fuel tank 5 litre; sound level 84 dB; Li-ion battery 25-50 Ah
Features: safety start, OPC, tow bar, fuel gauge, head lights, grass-bag-full indicator, hour meter, cast iron front axle, front bumper, anti-scalp deck wheels
notes: GeM bid document only (9 pages); buyer-uploaded ATC file referenced but not included. Short duration bid published citing emergency procurement. Consignee officers named with mobile numbers and a named buyer e-mail are printed in the document (not recorded). Vengurla consignee address does not say Vengurla Point explicitly; matched per listing title. File name number 7786776 differs from bid number 6182504.
